integrity: Analytic proof is self-contained; finite exact-rational checks are supplementary, not universal proofs. Existing diagonal variance is credited to its source.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent random points on the circle only; exact covariance and strict positive definiteness, not full joint law. Uninspected complete text of arXiv:2606.07028v1 leaves priority risk; no external independent validation.
title: Exact multiscale covariance and microscopic correlation profile for circular number variance
